policies.description: Only users with the Administrator role (admin) have full Create, Read, Update, Delete access across all tables, and therefore are authorized to update user records.
references: Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables.

policies.description: Any request to update a record must include and validate all mandatory fields required for that operation.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: When updating a user record, the target user must have the field users.active = true.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.

policies.description: The system must never assume or fabricate identifiers; all IDs used in the update must come from verified API results.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.

policies.description: The update_user_details call must be performed as a single validated operation; no additional operations should be bundled with it.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.

policies.description: If any of the above policies would be violated by the requested update, the operation must be halted and the specific policy reason returned before proceeding.
references: Policy Violation: If a user request violates any rule herein, you must halt the operation and provide the specific policy reason before pausing.
